title: Local Cognitive Compute Substrate
central_answer: SentientOS should own identity and evidence contracts around replaceable mature inference runtimes, plus a governed extension boundary for narrowly justified accelerator implementations; it should not presently own an independent inference runtime.

current_stack.current_state: independent LOCAL_MODEL_INFERENCE admission and digest-bound receipt
activation, serving currentness, content-bound artifact, and opaque session custody
exact commissioned Python runtime and llama_cpp worker are bound; full backend build provenance is not yet a first-class compute identity
SentientOS passes configuration including n_ctx and n_gpu_layers but does not own the detailed operation graph
catalog routes distinguish cpu, cuda, rocm, and metal while hardware compatibility and runtime availability remain separate facts
no general-purpose SentientOS-owned accelerator kernel library
observed as evidence, never inferred as runtime availability or authority

verified_current_reality.artifact_identity: model artifacts are streamed and content-bound by SHA-256 and byte size in hardened paths
verified_current_reality.selection: deterministic, catalog- and host-evidence-based; selection performs no runtime availability check
verified_current_reality.stage_rule: each stage is distinct and does not imply the next
verified_current_reality.production_serving: binds current activation, exact artifact identity, runtime_id, authority map, and loaded identity
verified_current_reality.transformers_cuda: available through delegated Transformers and PyTorch behavior when device=cuda; it is not a SentientOS kernel
verified_current_reality.cuda_posture: Docker and compatibility setup install or select third-party accelerated runtimes and libraries
verified_current_reality.custom_kernel_posture: none owned as a general-purpose production substrate
verified_current_reality.availability_distinction: hardware compatibility, driver presence, runtime/backend build availability, and successful load are separate observations

delegated_components.local_boundary: local-files-only configuration, model identity and governed invocation

NVIDIA device runtime and optimized primitives

process, memory, device and driver execution

terminology.model_identity: semantic identity used to name selected cognitive machinery; not a runtime, backend, or kernel
terminology.model_artifact: exact content bytes, format, SHA-256 and size
terminology.quantization: numeric representation encoded in or applied to an artifact; part of experimental configuration, not hardware identity
terminology.inference_runtime: software that loads a model and orchestrates inference
terminology.runtime_build: exact runtime source/version, build recipe, compiler, flags, dependencies and binary digest
terminology.accelerator_backend: runtime adapter targeting CPU, CUDA, ROCm, Metal, or another execution family
terminology.execution_primitive: bounded operation exposed to a runtime, such as matrix multiplication, attention, normalization, sampling, or transfer
terminology.kernel_artifact: exact compiled or source implementation of an execution primitive with build and provenance identity
terminology.driver_runtime_stack: OS driver, vendor runtime and libraries between backend and hardware
terminology.performance_evidence: attributable observations from a fixed compute profile; never correctness or adoption authority
terminology.control_plane_collision_rule: Local Cognitive Compute Substrate does not rename or mean ControlPlaneKernel

identity_distinctions.experimental_rule: changing one identity axis while fixing the others is an explicit intervention; backend or kernel replacement must not silently mutate model identity

correctness_equivalence_contract.reference: an exact admitted reference compute profile, normally CPU or an established upstream runtime, fixed by all identity axes
required_evidence: exact output equality for deterministic integer or otherwise exactly specified primitives
declared absolute and relative tolerance by dtype and operation where bitwise equality is impractical
logit and token-distribution comparison with declared metrics and thresholds
deterministic fixture vectors covering shapes, boundaries, dtypes, masks, context positions and failure cases
fixed-seed prompt-to-token regression with tokenizer and sampling configuration identity
perplexity or task-level regression on locally owned versioned evaluation data where primitive-level comparison is insufficient
crash, timeout, device-loss, out-of-memory and malformed-input behavior
memory-safety, bounds, race and sanitizer evidence where the programming model permits
correctness_equivalence_contract.admission_rule: all applicable evidence classes and operation-specific thresholds must pass; approximately looks right is forbidden
correctness_equivalence_contract.variance_rule: nondeterminism must be bounded statistically with sample count, seed policy and confidence rule declared before measurement
correctness_equivalence_contract.failure_rule: missing evidence, undeclared tolerance, changed model/tokenizer/quantization, nonreproducible result, or unsafe fault behavior fails closed

performance_evidence_contract.authority: performance evidence informs comparison only and cannot authorize adoption

candidate_lifecycle_invariant: no lifecycle stage implies or authorizes its successor

rules: CPU or another independently specified reference remains available where practical
backend-specific implementation never becomes SentientOS system identity
a CUDA-first experiment may be evidence-based but may not redefine local cognition as NVIDIA-only

capability_preservation_posture.definition: versioned, locally custodied knowledge and artifacts sufficient to understand, rebuild, test, compare and deliberately adopt a compute implementation without requiring the same external engineering assistant
capability_preservation_posture.priority_answer: Front-load identity schemas, reproducible build manifests, equivalence fixtures and metrics, benchmark methodology, native-code custody, and replaceable backend interfaces. These require subtle cross-hardware reasoning and make later kernel work objectively testable. Do not front-load broad kernel implementation or an independent runtime before measured gaps exist.

considered_ownership_models.reason: does not preserve attributable build, equivalence, or selective extension competence

considered_ownership_models.portability: preserved through replaceable implementations and references
considered_ownership_models.auditability: high for owned extensions and manifests
considered_ownership_models.numerical_risk: bounded per operation by equivalence gates
considered_ownership_models.reason: smallest posture that fills the evidence and substitution gap

considered_ownership_models.auditability: potentially high with a very large proof surface
considered_ownership_models.reason: duplicates mature runtimes without a demonstrated gap or sustainable maintenance basis

selected_architecture.delegation_default: continue using mature llama.cpp and PyTorch/Transformers implementations
selected_architecture.extension_trigger: a measured material gap, stable bounded operation, reproducible reference, objective acceptance thresholds, explicit maintenance owner, and a custody-safe loading path
selected_architecture.independent_runtime_trigger: only repeated strategic gaps that cannot be solved upstream or through bounded governed extensions and whose lifetime benefit exceeds portability and maintenance cost

candidate_domains.ownership_benefit: possible context latency and memory gains
auditability and deterministic semantics more than speed

custom_programming_model_decision.current_justification: none until identity, equivalence, benchmark, and native-code custody foundations exist and a measured upstream gap is demonstrated
custom_programming_model_decision.cuda_cpp: evaluate for an NVIDIA-specific operation only when vendor-library integration, low-level control, or stable deployment outweighs portability cost
custom_programming_model_decision.triton: evaluate first for a bounded tensor operation in an existing PyTorch path when rapid readable experimentation and objective cross-checking are more valuable than maximum low-level control
custom_programming_model_decision.custom_pytorch_extension: use only when the selected operation must integrate with PyTorch and the extension boundary can be narrowly custodied
custom_programming_model_decision.llama_cpp_ggml_patch: prefer upstream contribution; carry a local patch only with exact source/build custody and an upstream-unavailable strategic need
custom_programming_model_decision.first_model_rule: Triton is not automatically superior to CUDA C++; choose only after the operation, target hardware, integration runtime, portability requirement, profiling evidence, and maintenance owner are fixed

training_surface_classification.detail: scores proposed code diffs, records failures, and invokes retraining dataset preparation
clusters failure records and writes JSONL examples plus a Markdown plan
extracts failure patterns into JSONL and planning text; aspirational finetuning wording is not an executor
queues, checks, rebases, holds, merges, and receipts pull requests

training_conclusion: No inspected surface provides a production model-weight training path.

vendored_llama_cpp_inventory.conclusion: SentientOSsecondary/llama.cpp is not a complete owned llama.cpp accelerator stack and cannot establish runtime or kernel custody.

resource_principal_connection.boundary: attribution does not create ResourceAllocation, entitlement, scheduling priority, performance policy, or effect authority

next_implementation_slice.scope: Define and validate a metadata-only manifest binding the existing exact model and serving lineage to runtime source/version, interpreter and package artifacts, backend family, compiler/build recipe, linked vendor libraries, driver/runtime stack, hardware identity, inference configuration, benchmark fixture identity, measurements, and correctness-result references.
next_implementation_slice.why_first: The repository already binds model and Python runtime custody but lacks the comparable identity below it. This slice creates objective evidence and substitution leverage before any benchmark harness, registry, equivalence runner, or kernel experiment and duplicates no mature kernel implementation.
